method: Whole-view comparison of each panorama (1148x1063, pitched up) with its dry render at the same size from the same camera at 90 degree vertical field of view; positions read on each feature's own row.
note: Compared with five April 2025 panoramas (Skeppsbrogatan x2, Södra Vallgatan x2, Östra Vallgatan) by rendering the model from their positions (GPS positions, camera 2.3 m; the Södra Vallgatan camera moved 5.8 m onto the road where GPS put it inside a house). The outer wall measured 3.9-4.1 m against 4.25 m modelled; the hedge about 1.3 m; the limes about 3.1 m above the rampart top. Calibration here is whole-view and coarse: tree and lawn placement in the parks is an estimate except for the 27 mapped trees and the lime row.
